children.value: > Fact From Story: Travis Kelce believes the National Football League’s coverage of his rumoured girlfriend Taylor Swift is a bit too much.
> > Fact From Story: “They’re overdoing it a little bit, for sure,” Kelce agreed. “Especially my situation. I think they’re just trying to have fun with it.”

> > > Fact From Story: In the New Heights podcase episode, titled “The NFL Needs to Calm Down”, Jason asked his brother plainly whether he thought the football was “overdoing it” with the coverage of Swift during the game.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: People generally know when they are being covered too much.
